recommendation.title: Full rest from running and cycling
details: Optional: 20–30 minutes of easy walking or gentle mobility.
Do not make up missed runs or add cross-training today.
Prioritise sleep, food and hydration; resume only after recovery improves.
recommendation.alternative: Full rest is preferred; optional easy walking or mobility only.
recommendation.reduce_or_stop: Stop activity for pain that changes gait, dizziness, unusual fatigue, illness, chest symptoms or other concerning symptoms.
